title: Lost or found a pet in Poland
question: What should I do if I lost my pet or found someone else's pet in Poland?
short_answer: If lost: post on OLX/Facebook groups, check local shelters (schronisko), contact Straż Miejska. If found: take to a vet to scan for a microchip — it identifies the owner instantly.
conditions: Lost your pet: immediately post on local Facebook groups (e.g. 'Zaginione zwierzęta Gdańsk') and OLX.pl
Contact your local animal shelter (schronisko) — stray animals are often brought there
Call Straż Miejska — they collect stray animals and keep records
Found a pet: take it to any vet clinic — they scan for a microchip for free
If chipped: owner details found instantly. If not: you can keep the pet temporarily or hand it to the shelter
Post in local Facebook groups and OLX with a photo
exceptions: You are not legally obligated to keep a found animal — you can hand it to a shelter
If you keep a found animal for more than a few days without looking for the owner: legal grey area
Shelters are required to keep an animal for 14 days before offering it for adoption
